t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are different colored gnomes and they appear in pairs , the orange, green, red and brown gnomes lead to a bright forest with a red basket and the pink, purple, yellow and blue lead to a dark forest with a yellow basket. The idea is to focus and know which gnome leads to the forest with the most mushrooms especially when there is a multiplier in the round.

vb_textbox.text: Hi there!This is just a little piece of advice from my experience playing the game. There are 8 different gnomes in different colors and they always appear in twos. The colors are red, yellow, green, blue, brown, orange, pink, purple. The most profitable gnomes in my own opinion are the red, green, yellow and blue gnomes especially when there is a multiplier. However, sometimes, the other gnomes also have high numbers of mushrooms so it is a little difficult to always know which ones will collect the most mushrooms so I would advise you to go with your instinct.
